prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic tight upper-body luxury studio portrait of one original approved adult woman against a neutral dark-gray seamless background.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with very long straight dark-brown hair, a white lace headscarf, glam makeup, and one visible eye looking directly through the fingers of her raised hand. She wears a black strapless bandeau top and a supplied glossy white bangle with its supplied black emblem treated as an attached graphic asset.
composition_elements: Mid-torso to head framing, body facing camera, left arm raised with fingers spread naturally across the forehead and eyebrow area, one eye visible through the fingers.
Other arm relaxed downward, clean dark-gray background with a subtle falloff gradient.
Preserve exact hand placement, headscarf texture, hair length, visible eye, bangle shape, and editorial restraint.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic front-left key light with defined shadow gradient across the face and arm, controlled specular skin highlights, and crisp separation from the dark background.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 upper-body portrait, full-frame camera with 85mm lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, realistic pores, lace, hair strands, and bangle gloss, subtle grain, cool neutral grade, no text or watermark.
